account: ZTE reports that it deployed its Nebula vision system at Taicang Port. An edge detector flags possible fire or smoke, and a larger cloud vision model checks the context to reject false positives. ZTE reports that the system eliminated 92% of false fire alarms and detected unsafe behavior. ZTE reports that it tested the system at Taicang Port on 65 videos, 30 with smoke and 35 without. It states that accuracy exceeded 90% and that the false alarm rate stayed below 5%. No independent source verifies these gains. Prevented injuries remain unestablished.
